race.description: Big River Trade Hume Mdn Hcp
race.comment: LUCSAIN (3) gets top billing in a maiden where the better chances are largely unseen under race pressure. Has trialled up stylishly in town and is expected to make a bright start. MR XPLODE (5) is the next key debutant, coming from the Ciaron Maher yard with two solid lead-up trials. Expecting him to be competitive. PRAIRIE STAR (12) has also trialled solidly at Warwick Farm and comes from a proven family, but she profiles slightly more as a place-and-improve filly unless the market says she is ready to win first time out. ENTIRELY OAK (10) carries the fitness edge and looks best out of the raced bunch. Drops back in trip off 42 days and is a place hope.
